edit.description: widen the heading grammar to CommonMark's leading indent, per the cited section
indented-heading cases in the existing fixture page

summary: Read a CommonMark-legal indented ATX heading as a heading in the cite resolver's section scan
acceptance: A heading indented one to three spaces both resolves as a cited section and bounds the section above it; four spaces stays content.
tests: a heading indented up to three spaces resolves as the cited section
a heading indented up to three spaces bounds the section above it
pins: a four-space-indented hash line resolves no section
notes: One scan, two answers about what markdown is: FENCE already allows CommonMark's up-to-three leading spaces, HEADING is column 0 only. An indented heading resolves nothing (gate refuses a valid cite) and silently unbounds the section above it (prompt renders past it). Latent in this repo's spec locus; live for a consumer whose spec files flume does not write.
